children: On October 14, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that it failed to meet Listing Rule 5450(a)(1) because its closing bid price was below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. The company has 180 days, until April 12, 2027, to regain compliance by maintaining a $1.00 bid price for at least 10 consecutive business days, and may implement a reverse stock split if needed. The notice has no immediate impact on Nasdaq listing, and the TSX listing is unaffected.
